title: Leave Me Alone 式收件箱退订审计 SaaS：隐私优先一键清订阅邮件
title_en: Inbox Unsubscribe Audit SaaS: Privacy-First Bulk Cleanup
summary: 连接 Gmail 后批量列出订阅邮件并一键退订/拉黑，免费退订 10 封、7 天通行证 19 美元、年付 48 美元起；原版 Stripe Live 验证约 1.4 万美元/月。复制者打隐私牌切一个垂直人群，务实目标月入 300-1500 美元。
summary_en: Connect Gmail, list every subscription sender, and unsubscribe or block in bulk; free for 10 unsubscribes, $19 for a 7-day pass, $48+/yr. Original verified at ~$14K/mo via Stripe Live.
verdict: Stripe Live 第三方验证的真实小生意，隐私卖点（不卖数据）是护城河；但 Google 安全审计与邮箱 OAuth 信任门槛不低，复制者务实稳态月入 300-1500 美元，C 级值得观察。

core_thesis.market_pain: 职场人的收件箱被订阅邮件淹没，手动逐封点退订又慢又烦；老牌 Unroll.me 靠卖用户数据赚钱，用户对隐私越来越不放心，宁愿付钱买一个「不卖数据」的干净工具。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 切口是信任而非功能：OAuth 只读扫描订阅发件人、批量退订加一键拉黑，承诺不存储邮件正文、不卖数据，过 Google 安全审计。定价用 7 天通行证 19 美元承接一次性大扫除需求，年付 48 美元起卖持续守护。复制者可选一个垂直人群（如自由职业者、网店卖家）做专属话术，不要做通用版。

workflow_steps.title: 锁定垂直人群与信任话术
workflow_steps.detail: 选一类邮箱最脏的人群（如自由职业者），列出他们最烦的订阅来源；把「不卖数据、只读扫描、随时断开」写成首页第一屏卖点。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 垂直人群与隐私卖点清单

workflow_steps.title: 订阅扫描与退订提取 MVP
workflow_steps.detail: 用 Gmail API 只读拉取带 List-Unsubscribe 头的邮件，按发件人聚合计数，提取退订链接与一键退订接口；本地处理、不存正文。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 订阅发件人聚合与退订链接提取跑通

workflow_steps.title: 免费额度与通行证付费墙
workflow_steps.detail: 免费退订 10 封验证价值，之后 7 天通行证 19 美元完成大扫除，年付 48 美元起卖持续拦截；Stripe 收款。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 免费额度 + 通行证付费闭环

workflow_steps.title: 隐私对比页与社区冷启
workflow_steps.detail: 做「vs Unroll.me 数据政策」对比页承接搜索；Product Hunt 与独立开发者社区发隐私优先故事，收集首批 30 位种子用户反馈。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 对比页流量与种子用户验证

pitfalls_to_avoid: 邮箱 OAuth 权限是信任命门：只申请最小只读范围，Google 安全审计要预留时间和费用；绝不存储邮件正文、绝不卖数据，隐私承诺写进政策并做到；一键退订失败要有手动链接兜底，别对发件人做误杀拉黑。

en.title: Inbox Unsubscribe Audit SaaS: Privacy-First Bulk Cleanup
en.summary: Connect Gmail, list every subscription sender, and unsubscribe or block in bulk; free for 10 unsubscribes, $19 for a 7-day pass, $48+/yr. Original verified at ~$14K/mo via Stripe Live.
en.verdict: A real small business verified via Stripe Live; privacy (never selling data) is the moat. Google security review and OAuth trust are the barrier. Copycat steady state $300-$1,500/mo. Tier C, worth watching.

deep_dive.opportunity: Inboxes are buried in subscription mail and manual unsubscribing is slow; the legacy leader monetizes user data, so a privacy-first tool that never sells data wins trust. Read-only Gmail scanning, bulk unsubscribe plus blocking, and a $19 seven-day pass for one-off cleanups form the wedge. Copycats should serve one vertical audience with tailored copy.
workflow: Phase 01: Pick one inbox-heavy audience and write the privacy promise (read-only, no body storage, no data sales) as the hero.
Phase 02: Ship read-only Gmail scanning that aggregates List-Unsubscribe senders and extracts one-click unsubscribe endpoints.
Phase 03: Gate with 10 free unsubscribes, then a $19 seven-day pass and $48+/yr annual plans via Stripe.
Phase 04: Launch with a data-policy comparison page against the legacy leader and one community launch for 30 seed users.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: OAuth scope is the trust bottleneck: request minimal read-only access and budget time and money for Google security review. Never store message bodies or sell data. Provide manual unsubscribe links as fallback when one-click fails, and avoid false-positive blocks.
